section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study (Study X) consisting of 322 female university students from Greater London, United Kingdom, with a mean age of 24.72 years and mean BMI of 21.67. The majority of participants (63.7%) were of European Caucasian descent, with smaller proportions of Asian (13.7%), African Caribbean (13.7%), and other ancestry (9.0%). All participants were university students, indicating 100% had college or higher education experience.
